cli.description: Path of Exile 1 build optimizer powered by the Path of Building calculation engine
cli.optionLinks: number of links in the main group

engine.starting: Starting the Path of Building engine…
engine.notInstalled: The Path of Building engine is not installed. Run first: npm run setup

search.isSupport: "{name}" is a support gem, not a main skill.

optimize.runningTree: Optimising the passive tree ({budget} points available)…
optimize.refining: Second pass on supports, with the tree and auras in place…

report.title: Recommended build
report.socketNote: Since 3.29 sockets have no colour requirement: any gem fits any socket (+10% quality when the colour matches).
report.noGain: No additional support improves this build for this goal.
report.bareBuildNote: This calculation is for a character with no gear and no allocated passive tree: absolute values are low, only the differences between supports are meaningful.
report.goalNoDefensiveEffect: Note: for this goal, no support gem changes your defences — a skill link only affects damage. The ranking above therefore falls back to DPS. Your survivability comes from the tree, auras and gear, handled separately below.
report.treePoints: {used} passive points used out of {budget} — {asc} ascendancy points
report.treeNoGain: No notable improves this build for this goal.
report.noGearNote: No gear is taken into account yet: absolute values stay low, but the tree and gems above are genuinely computed.

priority.damage: This goal favours stats that multiply damage.
priority.life: This goal favours the life and energy shield pool.
priority.tankiness: This goal favours mitigation and resistances.
priority.balanced: This goal seeks a compromise between damage and survivability.

damage.label: Increased / skill damage
damage.why: additive with each other, stack them on the tree

damage.label: Crit chance and crit multiplier
damage.why: raise both together or neither is worth it

life.label: Flat maximum life on gear
life.why: the base the percentages apply to

life.label: Hybrid energy shield
life.why: if the class and ascendancy suit it

life.label: Recovery (regen, leech)
life.why: a pool that never refills is useless

tankiness.label: Elemental resistances capped (75%)
tankiness.why: absolute priority, before any other defence

tankiness.label: Chaos resistance
tankiness.why: often neglected, expensive in the endgame

audit.title: Build audit
audit.resUncapped: {res} resistance not capped: {value}% ({missing} points short of 75%)
audit.resOvercapLow: Low overcap ({overcap}%): an Elemental Weakness map will push you under the cap
audit.chaosResLow: Negative chaos resistance ({value}%): a classic endgame weak spot
audit.lowLifePool: Low effective life pool ({pool}) for endgame
audit.lowDps: Low DPS ({dps}): will be limiting on endgame bosses

import.loaded: Build imported: {class} / {asc} level {level} — {groups} link groups, {items} items
import.treeVersionMismatch: Warning: this build targets tree {version}, while the current league is 3.29. Values may differ.

web.slowNote: A full optimisation runs hundreds of Path of Building calculations: expect several minutes. Lower the tree point budget for a quick test.
web.empty: Run an optimisation or import a build to see results here.

gear.title: Recommended gear
gear.pricesUnavailable: Prices unavailable (poe.ninja unreachable): the budget tier could not be applied, all uniques were considered.
gear.uniquesOnly: Only unique items are proposed. A real build mostly relies on rares with chosen mods, which this tool cannot craft yet.
gear.partialSearch: {tested} uniques tested per slot out of {total} available: the search is partial.

rare.title: Rare items to aim for
rare.notASimulator: This is not a crafting simulator: no probabilities or currency are modelled. It describes the item to LOOK FOR or AIM AT, using only affixes that can actually roll on this base at this item level.
rare.rollNote: Values shown are top-of-range; trade links search from {ratio}% of that value.
rare.modsLoaded: {mods} mods and {bases} bases loaded from Path of Building

aura.title: Auras
aura.note: Auras are the strongest defensive lever in the game, but their mana reservation is a hard constraint: one aura too many makes the main skill unusable.
aura.unblocking: Re-running the tree with the blocked auras ({list}): looking for reservation…

corpus.noSource: Give at least one link, code, or a file with -f.
corpus.empty: Empty corpus. Add builds with: pba corpus add -f my-builds.txt
corpus.addDone: {added} added, {updated} updated, {failed} failed — {total} builds in corpus.
corpus.priorUsed: Corpus: {n} known supports for {skill} (from {builds} builds) — tested first.
corpus.priorMissing: Corpus: no build with {skill}, default order.

config.using: Combat conditions — {config}. Any DPS figure only means something relative to these.
